newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on January 17.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on January 17.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on January 17, a central bank official said on Thursday.
The issue volume of all papers was set at 10 million hryvnias, the chief economist of the bank's market and exchange department Oleg Belinsky told Reuters.
At the last three-month T-bill sale on January 15, the bank sold 13.25 million hryvnias of paper, with an average annualised yield of 45.31 percent. The average price was 89.85 hryvnias.
The bank sold 120.01 million hryvnias in six-month T-bills on January 14, with an average annualised yield of 58.86 percent and an average price of 77.31 hryvnias.

At the last auction of nine-month discount T-bills on January 15, the bank sold 16.16 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yields of 60.07 percent. The average price was 69.00 hryvnias.
The bank sold 991,000 hryvnias of 12-month discount T-bills on January 15, with an average annualised yield of 60.50 percent and an average price of 62.37 hryvnias.
